audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was 'Tryndamere' under a why calling it neutral, and levels 4-5 were 'Skill' under a why saying he edges ahead there.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Tryndamere, Zaahen, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere] and the whys match it; Tryndamere is at 48.24% over 1136 games, consistent with him losing the 4-5 bracket.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 3 realigned in both layers, level 3's rating raised to match a Tryndamere-sided row, and phases[3].why rewritten to say why Zaahen owns 4-5.

audit.why: Spike ordering is right: your level-3 window, his 4-5 rhythm, the level-6 timing duel, then your crit item. Grim Deliverance is 110/95/80s, so the level-6 stage genuinely turns on one long cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names: his E is called 'Golden Onslaught' in spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[1], and his R is called 'Final Retribution' in spikes[2]. The real names are Aureate Rush (E) and Grim Deliverance (R). The Q auto-reset tell, the W pull range, the E max-health damage and the R self-heal were all absent.
audit.why: The repo's own interaction data names them The Darkin Glaive (Q), Aureate Rush (E) and Grim Deliverance (R). Riot kit: Q is an auto-attack reset that heals him and recasts into a knockup (10/9/8/7/6s); W stabs and pulls at 850 range (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s); E is flagged percentHealth, so armour stacking is the wrong answer; R heals him for a portion of damage dealt.
audit.corrected: Renamed E and R everywhere they appear in prose, and rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with the reset tell, the pull range, the max-health warning and the R heal.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ultimate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His Q poke and E burst punish every empty-Fury window here, so trade only at full rage. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: His Q Darkin Glaive poke and E Golden Onslaught burst punish you whenever Fury is empty; build Fury on the wave first and never trade from zero rage.
edits.after: His Q Darkin Glaive poke and E Aureate Rush burst punish you whenever Fury is empty; build Fury on the wave first and never trade from zero rage.

edits.before: His R Final Retribution can beat your all-in only if he times it around Undying Rage's expiry - hold your R late, spin out of his lock window, and heal the rest back.
edits.after: His R Grim Deliverance can beat your all-in only if he times it around Undying Rage's expiry - hold your R late, spin out of his lock window, and heal the rest back.

edits.before: At 4-5 he edges ahead - Q Darkin Glaive poke taxes you between waves and E Golden Onslaught bursts you whenever your rage bar is empty, so trade only at full Fury. Level 6 is a timing duel: his R lockdown is lethal if it catches Undying Rage on cooldown, but if you save R for his commit you flat-out cannot die.
edits.after: At 4-5 he edges ahead - Q Darkin Glaive poke taxes you between waves and E Aureate Rush bursts you whenever your rage bar is empty, so trade only at full Fury. Level 6 is a timing duel: his R lockdown is lethal if it catches Undying Rage on cooldown, but if you save R for his commit you flat-out cannot die.

edits.before: E Golden Onslaught burst then instant disengage
edits.after: E Aureate Rush burst then instant disengage

edits.before: His big cooldown. R survives its burst. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance heals him for the damage it deals and is down 110s at rank 1.

edits.before: Build 100 fury on the wave, E-spin onto Zaahen with a crit loaded, AA-W slow, and spin out before the answer.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Darkin Glaive auto reset, not a visible cast — step back on the wind-up, not the animation.

edits.before: That is Zaahen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His W pull is 850 range and his Q recast knocks up — hold your E for that.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His E takes a cut of your max health — armour alone is not enough.
